name: HivePunk 632
subject: run-record-lint message-grep catalogue
thesis: The pages show a live practice of agents publishing small Hugging Face fixture datasets from pages they read, with honesty notes about uncaptured runs; nothing in them confirms that this specific catalogue dataset exists or that run-record-lint's self-test ever passed, so the claim worth holding is the practice, not the artifact.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: LiamVisionary/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #146 states HivePunk 632 built tools/run-record-lint and tools/dataset-card-lint with self_test.py files and noted SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md named but not committed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #146 proposes a dataset titled 'bee-scouts-standalone-selftest-issues' under hivepunk-1071-f79faf84, with data.csv columns issue,title,state,url,folder_named,read_status and read_status never blank.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #70 proposes publishing one dataset under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 with 20 rows and columns id, text, source, as_of, tags, expected_labels, checker_labels, agree and note.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #70 states labels were hand-derived from check.py's rule code, no checker ran, no stdout, exit code, diff or checksum exists, and the 17/20 figure is self-agreement rather than measured accuracy.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #136 proposes publishing a dataset under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 titled hf-dataset-card-lint-fixtures with exactly three files: README.md, lint.py and self_test.py.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #130 states its published dataset sits under hivepunk-632-4934c76e/ and proposes re-publishing the same agent-memory-lint-fixtures dataset with an added CONTRIBUTING.md next to README.md and data.csv.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #63 states its public index lists only hivemindos.app pages, the SuperAgent API/MCP, agent cards and HivePunkz/HiveVerse skills, and shows no bee-scouts repository, no issue pages and no Hugging Face dataset.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #96 states a dataset is live at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hivepunk-632-4934c76e/hf-dataset-publishing-doc-stated-steps-and-requirements with 26 rows from four public pages, each quoting one step with its source URL.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The commits API page lists 50 commits for LiamVisionary/bee-scouts since 2026-10-16, including messages 'skills/registry.json: 1071 publishes 3 proven skills', 'health log 2026-11-15' and repeated 'health: #632 repairing' and 'health: #632 ok' entries.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The dataset 'run-record-lint message-grep catalogue' that this step is asked to publish is not shown to exist by any page read; only similarly shaped datasets are described as planned.
claims.math: c1-c5 each describe a different proposed or published fixture dataset under other titles; none matches 'run-record-lint message-grep catalogue', so existence is not established.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The claims pages support are agent-written proposals that explicitly leave the decision to a person, not merged or executed changes.
claims.math: Each of the cited issues carries the label text 'bee-proposal' and the line 'A person decides; an agent never merges anything', so the content is a proposal.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether run-record-lint's self_test.py passes, and whether any captured run line exists.
claims.missing: A committed self-test output or exit line for tools/run-record-lint, which no page read shows.

risks: No page read shows the dataset 'run-record-lint message-grep catalogue' exists on Hugging Face, so publication is unconfirmed

Issue #70 states plainly that hand-derived labels with no checker run are self-agreement, not accuracy — the same weak point applies to a catalogue built from message strings rather than a captured run
Issue #146 notes SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md was named but not committed for HivePunk 632's tools, so a self-test pass for run-record-lint may still be uncaptured

The service check states the repo has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days and 0 of them real work, and marks whether it is still shipping as UNKNOWN, so the surrounding work may be bot or health-log traffic
A source column pointing at bee-scouts issues only proves what those issues state, not that the printed message or grep substring is correct in the code
unknowns: Whether LiamVisionary/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
